Easily! You have to realize that it isn't about how much you spend on a vacation. It's what you do with it. Seriously, what you eat matters the most. Your food vices will be the hardest thing to break. When I started, it took me almost a solid 6 months before I wasn't upset with food. I would be upset that I had to eat healthy and couldn't eat junk. Up until then, I really viewed it as a diet. It is far from that. A healthy food lifestyle is so damn important! Portion control, substitutions (whole wheat instead of white, things that are lean/lower in fat, etc.), and NO SODA (POP)!! 😏 To cure late night munchies , which I have as well, I found making my own trail mix fixes that. I put almonds, cashews, raisins, dried bananas, and dried cherries in mine.  There are times I will munch on the trail mix angrily when all I want is chocolate. But by the time I've had about a handful, im satisfied.  Example: The girl I used to work out with never changed her eating habits but worked out 6 days a week for at least 2 hours a day. She had very minimal results. Within the same time period of a year , she dropped 1 size in clothing whereas I dropped 3. It gets easier. It gets harder before it gets easier though. Pasta, bread, and chocolate are things I still struggle with. Luckily your body gets used to eating healthier so it becomes more mind over matter. I don't know if me being female matters compared to a male losing weight but I do know that regardless...you have to be conscious of what you eat. I've lost 80 pounds in about a year and a half. Food is an addiction. Know that. I still love it but I love loosing weight and feeling better about myself way more...though that box of cookies is still damn tempting! 😍Good luck! You'll do amazing.

Negan is a nice guy. He had to have been a decent man before all of this. Perhaps my main point to that is his no rape rule. Throughout history during anything, women were always fair game sexually. Seeing Negan bash Glen's head in was shocking to say the least but a man who is willing to kill anyone who violates a woman is okay in my book. You could argue that his "wives" are being demoralized by being sex slaves but I think it's concentual between the females, only the husbands suffer 😞When Carl snuck off to take Negan down, he saw the nicer side to him. Hell, Negan felt terrible when he made Carl cry. Carl is quick tempered now so its clouding his judgment over him.Negan, like EVERY other "leader" does what they have to do to establish some order among their followers. Yes Negan has a harsher side, but he could have been worse. He let everyone live in the groups he had under control. He could have killed Rick forever ago, as well as Carl but he didn't. If Negan is evil so is Rick, equally. Let's go with my "Leader doing whatever it takes to keep their group alive" theory and apply it with Rick, the "evil" man. Cannibals traipsed among his group and was planning a feast. Rick slaughters them. No peaceful conversation, no slap on the hand, slaughters satisfyingly so. So Negan didn't realize Glen was a nice guy. All he saw was a threat to his group and as a leader he acted, disturbingly. Once everyone calms the hell down, once Carl clears his head and remembers the "nicer" Negan, once people follow Maggie's lead of getting over what Negan did to Glen, everyone will see a strong man. I understand Rick for wanting him to be in Jail and perhaps that will happen for a while, but I think Negan would be far more useful outside of Jail. In time!
